notes.title: Alpha League Release Preview
notes.content:
Elite members of the Alpha League:

Thank you for your interest in our development progress! As promised, we will officially release "Alpha League" on February 23rd as scheduled. In the past two weeks, due to our intensive work on the final quality polishing, there have been no updates to the test server. Therefore, we would like to take this opportunity to preview the updates that will be released on the official server. Without further ado, let's get into the details.

Part One: The Opening of Alpha League Season 0
Please join our community to claim benefits, receive firsthand information, and team up with other players:

 Discord
 Reddit
 Twitter


We are pleased to announce that Season 0 of the Alpha League will commence simultaneously with the official server release (starting on February 23rd) and will end on May 31st, 2024. At the end of the season, rewards will be distributed based on ranking as follows:

1st place in Rank: Title "Season 0 Tyrant" + 20,000 Alpha Coins + 500,000 Beta Coins
2nd place in Rank: Title "Season 0 Conqueror" + 10,000 Alpha Coins + 200,000 Beta Coins
3rd place in Rank: Title "Season 0 Lord" + 6,000 Alpha Coins + 100,000 Beta Coins
Rank 4-10: Title "Season 0 Guardian" + 4,000 Alpha Coins + 50,000 Beta Coins
Rank 11-200: Title "Season 0 Warrior" + 2,000 Alpha Coins + 15,000 Beta Coins

If none of the above rankings apply to you, you can still receive rewards if you meet the following conditions at the end of the season:

 ELO above 2000: Title "Season 0 Navigator" + 1,500 Alpha Coins + 8,000 Beta Coins
 ELO above 1600: Title "Season 0 Explorer" + 1,000 Alpha Coins + 5,000 Beta Coins

Additionally, we will gift all players with a free "Lizard Sunny" courier if their elo point is above 1200.

As a token of appreciation for your support, during the first four-week period of the official server's opening (until March 22nd), the hero synergies level within matches will be set to level 15 for all players. Nevertheless, hero synergy development outside matches can proceed as usual.

Meanwhile, we will conclude the test server season at 23:59 BJT/16:59 CET/07:59 PST on February 21st and shut down the test server. Please make necessary preparations in advance. As promised earlier, we will retain all progression for test server players, only resetting rank points, Alpha Pass progress, and 7-day login reward progress.

Part Two: Major Updates
[olist]
 Season 0 version will support 10 languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Russian, French, German, Polish, Portuguese, Spanish, Turkish.
 "Alpha League" will also be available on the Epic Games Store, allowing players to play through the Epic Games Store.
 We have further restricted the resolution of all textures, making "Alpha League" smoother on low-end PCs.
 We have made significant updates to the in-game interface aesthetics. Although it is not the final version yet, you should be able to already feel the artistic atmosphere of the official server.
[/olist]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44786857/e14623d530c9cccc06a918cbbf62a5d69a65585f.jpg

Part Three: Content Changes
Due to some unresolved issues with the animation of "Opal (Sky Mecha)," we have decided to temporarily retire Opal from the hero list. The new hero "Malachite (Crunch Mecha)" will inherit Opal's card level, and the hero mechanics will remain largely the same.

The new hero "Nostredame (Spell Master)" will also make its debut on the official server. Nottingham is a grand mage from the "Secret Order," and there is no magic in this world that he cannot master.

 Talent: Versatility, with each different skill learned, ultimate boost +1%.
 Ultimate: Starshift, Nostredame always uses the opponent's ultimate. If the steal fails, a normal spell dealing 200 magic damage will be cast.


The new hero "Samuel (The Wrath)" will also be introduced on the official server. Samuel is the first warrior from the "Underworld," a newly discovered Earth neighbor following human advances in drilling technology. The "Hell Shrine" belongs to the underworld, and the people of this civilization excel at breaking enemy defenses.

 Talent: Demolishing, in combat, opponent's physical damage reduction, magic reduction, and evasion chance -10%
 Ultimate: Melting Slash, deal 100 physical damage, and over 3 seconds, burn 2% of enemy's curren HP every second (magic damage)


The new map "Lost Holyland" will soon be available on the official server. This was the headquarters of the "Sanctum Organization" in the Middle Ages, and the sanctum, which was once the most powerful organization on primitive Earth, has gradually declined with the advancement of technology and the development of superpowers. The task of reviving the sanctum now falls on the shoulders of the contemporary saint, "Jenny."

 Map Effect: Every second, everyone heals 40 HP, all debuffs decay stacks +50%

We have upgraded the combat animations of all heroes, so now the combat actions will not be excessively jerky.
Models, effects, and original art of heroes like Alicia, Judy, Colin, Emerald, Kay, James, Heimdall, and Sylvie have been upgraded.
We have added more than 30 couriers for players to meet in the shop.

Part Four: Balance Adjustments
We believe that the current map system has too little impact on the game, and currently, this system seems more like a cosmetic effect. Therefore, we have decided to strengthen the impact of the map system on late-game battles.

 Space Lab #47: Everyone gets 2 extra artifact dices
 Hell Shrine: Everyone's healing amount -20%, evasion chance - 10%
 Necro Earth: Every 1 second, everyone curses enemy by 20 stacks, shield decay stacks +30%
 Snowline Altar: Every 1 second, everyone freezes enemy by 20 stacks, frost decay stacks -30%
 Oasis of Khepri: Every 1 second, everyone poisons enemy by 20 stacks, poison settle is 10% faster

We believe that the changes to Jenny in the previous version were effective; she is currently strong enough in the early game but often becomes an unmanageable presence in the late game. Therefore, we decided to make a slight nerf to her late-game abilities.

 Passive nerf: Healing effect increased 30% -> 15%.


Part Five: Miscellaneous
[olist]
 The mailbox system will be launched soon.
 The ranking points reward system will be launched soon.
 The title system will be launched soon.
 The number of shards in the 7-day login reward, per hero: from 50 to 500.
 In the "Daily Treats" section of the store, the number of free card acquisitions will increase from 10 to 50.
 Bedivere's supply vouchers will be launched soon, providing a more affordable option for Alpha Coins (22 times the value).
 Shortening optimizations have been made to the skill text descriptions of all heroes and cards.
[/olist]

As development progresses, there may be additional updates. Please stay tuned to our official community for the latest news.

Wishing you all a happy Spring Festival and a harmonious family reunion.

Beaveroid Entertainment, all staff.

notes.title: 24/01/27 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Preface
For those of you who are interested in trying out Alpha League early. Our Playtest Server is now open to public. If you want to join, simply apply for the Playtest on Store Page. 

We are expecting a server maintenance around Jan. 27th 10am CET/1am PST/5pm BJT. The maintenance will continue for about 1 hour. Like every week before, please restart Steam to update the game client.

Part. 1 Content
1. We have temporarily retired Marble, because we cannot fix his texture issue for the moment. We apologize to those who love Marble, and we expect Marble to be back soon.
2. A new hero - the North Berserker "Eyvar" is available for play now. Please check for details in Library. Eyvar is tanky and mainly deals damage by critical hits.

Part. 2 Balance
1. Buff: the healing amount for Adrenaline (Heal Genre Legendary Skill) has been 33% increased.
2. Rework: talents (passive skill) of Jenny and Alicia are stronger now in early game (because we find new players may fail 1-7 monster round with these 2 heroes) and slightly weaker in late game.
3. Reworked mechanism of Credit card. You can always overdraft now.
4. Buffed damage of Damage Reflection (Shield+Curse Normal Skill), check out in library.
5. You can now pick identical heroes.

Part. 3 Miscellaneous
1. Fixed reconnection issue. When players quit lobby or are disconnected for a long time, they should still be able to reconnect. Especially when play as a team.
2. Tweaked the Elo System. It will be easier for a good player to climb the ladder. However, when a player loses, he or she also loses more elo points.
3. Improved Bot intelligence. New players should be able to experience a smoother learning curve.
4. Improved UI in several places. We will keep improving the UI.
5. Keep improving performance on earlier specs computers.
6. Fixed sound effect bug for Opal.
7. Fixed all the known bugs.
8. Fixed some text mistakes.

Expectation for next week
1. Allocate more currency resources (through Rank Rewards and so on) to players, so cultivating a few main heroes will be faster.
2. We will try to fix the Steamdeck compatibility issue.
3. Lobby UI upgrade (as surveyed earlier at Discord/Reddit).
4. We are planning about new heroes/genres/artifacts/maps before the official release, but this may taker longer than next week. Thank you for being patient with us. We hope you enjoy the time with Pals.
